sources.excerpt: Empress Effects Request for Repair/Return Empress Effects Inc Empress Effects Request for Repair/Return Is something wrong with your pedal? Are you not totally satisfied with your purchase? Please fill out this form to help us help you. We’ll respond to you shortly! Most problems occur because an incompatible power supply is being used. See if your power supply is compatible here Reason for Sending * Reason for Sending * Repair Return Are you an Empress Dealer/Distributor? * Are you an Empress Dealer/Distributor? * Yes No Product * please select a product Bass ParaEq Bass Compressor (Blue) Bass Compressor (Silver) Buffer Buffer+ Buffer++ Buffer+ Stereo Compressor Mk II (Blue) Compressor Mk II (Silver) Compressor Distortion Drive Echosystem ECM-519 Fuzz Germ Heavy Heavy Menace Midibox Multidrive Nebulus ParaEq (Original) ParaEq MKII ParaEq MKII Deluxe ParaEq MKII Deluxe Black Phaser Reverb Superdelay Tape Delay Tremolo1 Tremolo2 Vintage Modified Superdelay ZOIA ZOIA 10K ZOIA Euroburo ZOIA Euroburo Desktop RMA Reference Number Your Internal RMA number Serial Number * Serial Numbers can be found on the bottom of your pedal’s box, on the back of the pedal, or inside the pedal on the lower lip. If you’ve checked all these places and your Serial Number is still missing, enter N/A in this field! What power supply are you using? * Where did you buy this pedal from? * Please indicate the music store / dealer you purchased the pedal from, or if it was purchased directly from Empress Effects. Purchase date An approximate date is fine if you're not sure Describe the problem. * How did you find this form? * How did you find this form? * Referred to it by an Empress employee. Attach a second video or picture for extra points! Okay, that's it, three's enough.
